title: Code-quality projections inhabit both content kinds

criteria.acceptance_criterion: Source layers keep their import direction
criteria.statement: Every import under src/ resolves within the source layers; the src-to-tests edge stays absent under the import-direction fitness function.
criteria.hollow_delivery: A module under src/ imports a helper from tests/ and the change lands green.

check.procedure: Run `python -m tooling.import_direction --root . --forbid src:tests` over the tree.
check.conforming_case: Every src/ import resolves within the source layers.
check.falsifying_case: A src/ module imports a tests/ helper and the run reports it.

criteria.acceptance_criterion: Keep it as simple as the need allows
criteria.statement: Asked of the diff: does every element added or kept trace to a need this change verifies? It holds when the constraint each new element serves is nameable at its locus.
criteria.hollow_delivery: A defensive abstraction, speculative parameter, or compatibility shim lands with no constraint that demands it.

check.procedure: Enumerate the diff's added or kept elements; for each, reconstruct the chain to the constraint it serves; flag any element whose constraint cannot be named at its locus.
check.observable: Every element traces to a named constraint — pass; any unearned element — fail.
check.conforming_case: Each new element's constraint is named at its locus in the finding.
check.falsifying_case: A speculative parameter lands justified only by 'might need it'.

criteria.acceptance_criterion: Fail loudly, early, and exactly once
criteria.statement: Asked of the diff: does each failure path the change adds surface its error where it occurs, named, exactly once? It holds when every new failure path has a loud, pointable locus.
criteria.hollow_delivery: A fallback introduced by the change silently masks an error and downstream code builds on the false success.

check.procedure: Enumerate the failure paths the diff adds; for each, reconstruct where its error surfaces and how often; flag any path whose error is masked or re-raised beyond once.
check.observable: Every new failure path has one loud, pointable locus — pass; any silent or duplicated path — fail.
check.conforming_case: Each new failure path's loud locus is pointed at in the finding.
check.falsifying_case: A new fallback swallows an error and the finding cannot point at a loud locus.
